name: concat_mla_absorb_q
description: MLA absorbed-query concatenation with signature concat_mla_absorb_q(a, b). a and b have shapes [dim0, dim1, a_last] and [dim0, dim1, b_last] and are concatenated along the last dimension. Return a newly allocated contiguous tensor of shape [dim0, dim1, a_last+b_last] and dtype a.dtype. The native implementation handles both contiguous inputs and arbitrary input strides without mutating either input. The suite exercises bfloat16 with a_last=512 and b_last=64 over 1/13/128/512 tokens and 16/128 heads.
